name: Logo Looper
description: Columns of brand logos that loop in and out with a blurred, color-fringed chromatic offset, each column staggered so the logos swap in a rolling wave.
contents: Grid of columns, each stacking several looping SVG logos
20 default brand logo icons as SVG paths
behavior: Each logo fades in with blur and diagonal movement, holds, then fades out the opposite way
Three colored fringe layers plus a current-color layer blend with hard-light
Columns are staggered by a sine-based delay
Logo order is shuffled on mount
editableByProps: Logo list (title and SVG path), column count, logos per column
Timing, stagger, movement, blur and overlap values
Logo color and the three fringe colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Change logo size or column spacing
needsCodeEdit.where: className of the main element and the svg with h-12

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Logos are SVG path data viewBox 0 0 24 24
Needs a background supplied by the host page, the component is transparent
